Name: L_FootBox
Description: Create foot boxes geos for the foot block

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Create foot boxes geos for the foot block. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. Color: choose one option (for example: pink, orange, blue, light_blue). ForceYZero: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. SetToes: set the node/object name this block should use. SetBallFloor: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: L_Foot_Ankle_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt. Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl.
